name: HotelRevenuePickupAnalyzer
tagline: Pace, pickup, forecast and rate decisions for hotels – inside Power Apps.
description: A complete hotel revenue-management module in one PCF control: rooms and revenue on the books vs same time last year, pickup by day and segment, forecast occupancy, a pace-calendar heat map, rule-based rate recommendations with reasons and an accept / override / reject / publish workflow. Works instantly with demo data; connect a collection, Dataverse, SharePoint or SQL in a few clicks, or use the Power Pages Web API.
features: 8 revenue KPIs (OTB, occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, pickup, pace vs LY, forecast, revenue opportunity)
Booking-pace chart with forecast, STLY and capacity
Month heat map by occupancy, forecast, pace or pickup
Rule-based rate recommendations with reasons, floors and ceilings
Accept / override / reject / publish workflow with transition rules and override reasons
Bulk accept within ±%, publish all decided
Search, filters, grouping, CSV export, undo
Phone, tablet and desktop layouts; keyboard and screen-reader support
controlType: standard (2 controls: dataset + Power Pages field control)
